ownerConstraints.rule: Do not claim first-hand use, testing, measurements, comfort, durability or performance. Default product evidence to official-spec; use research-synthesis only when every external test preserves its source, setup, result, interpretation and limitation.
ownerConstraints.structuredData: Review structured data remains prohibited unless the owner later supplies genuine first-hand evidence and explicitly changes this constraint.

allowedWork: Repair evidence, sources, compatibility and exact-product identity on existing pages
Improve meaningful page-one zero-click and page-two pages
Merge or retire only after the recorded cohort gate and live index/demand review
Fix confirmed technical, merchant-link, rendering or attribution failures
blockedWork: New Review or Best claims without qualifying evidence
Changing a protected page from a single 24-hour movement

canonicalInventoryBaseline.scope: All published base-canonical editorial routes after applying current permanent-consolidation rules, including factory-generated products, factory-generated guides, the 151 research-pool guides and the governed family guides that remain canonical. The 240 consolidated guide sources, home pages, category archives and localized compatibility editions are tracked separately and are not counted as editorial base pages.
canonicalInventoryBaseline.localizedEditions: Locale editions inherit the evidence and lifecycle decision of their base canonical; they are not independent content-production targets.

googleSearchConsole.note: The full URL ledger is generated from the most recent repository CSV through 2026-09-30; the newer live headline and leading-page evidence are recorded here and must replace it at the next full export.

amazonAssociates.interpretation: Do not treat cookie-assisted order conversion as proof that the recommended products fit the landing-page intent.

baby.boundary: Use manufacturer and pediatric safety boundaries; do not turn product research into medical or universal safety advice.

reviewGates.required: Review every URL in the October 6 cohort and separate indexed-but-unexposed pages from discovery, canonical or demand failures.
Compare CTR, average position, page/query exposure and internal discovery; change only pages with meaningful evidence.

reviewGates.gate: October 6 release day 30 and portfolio decision
reviewGates.required: Join organic visits, affiliate clicks, direct items and earnings; expand no cluster unless it passes the recorded economics and intent gates.

scaleGates.targetDirectItemShare: Material improvement from the 1 of 11 baseline; do not use indirect orders alone.
scaleGates.rule: The $0.10 target is an internal operating threshold, not an industry guarantee. If the November 5 evidence does not show repeated query clusters and materially better direct-product economics, keep only proven pages and continue maintenance rather than expanding inventory.
